STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for Goods and Services contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.defined_by: clause 1.4 and App B footnote ***; values "published on the Procurement Intranet page"
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source before spend-analyst runs.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for Works and Concession contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION.defined_by: clause 1.4 and App B footnote *** ("Works and concession contracts")
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source before spend-analyst runs.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for Light Touch contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source before spend-analyst runs.

THRESHOLD_BY_CONTRACT_TYPE.description: "the Threshold" / "the relevant Threshold" where the rule does not name a contract type: resolves to STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES, STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSION or STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH according to the contract type
THRESHOLD_BY_CONTRACT_TYPE.note: Not a separate figure; spend-analyst must map each transaction/contract to a contract type to apply it. The PDF gives no rule for doing so.

notes: Placeholders left in the text: the document title is "Part []" (p1) and App A row 3 cites "Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)" (p11).

VAT contradiction: 6.15 says Total Contract Value includes "Value Added Tax" (p5), but the App B value column is "Total Value exclusive of VAT" (p12). Spend data "Net amount" is presumably ex-VAT; banding results depend on which basis is applied.

Statutory thresholds are not in the PDF: 1.4, 6.5 and App B footnote *** say they are "published on the Procurement intranet page". All four parameters are null; every rule with a *_ref bound cannot be tested until the auditor supplies them with a source.

1.4 lists four threshold categories (Goods & Services, Works, Concession, Light Touch) but App B footnote *** lists three (works and concession combined). The "***" marker itself does not appear anywhere in the App B table (orphan footnote).

Boundary gap at exactly £500,000: App A row 2 is "less than £500,000" and row 3 "Above £500,000"; App B row B2 is "less than £500,000" and row C "Above £500,000". A contract of exactly £500,000 falls in no band. (4.3 and 7.4.3 use "over £500,000"; 7.4.2 uses "up to £500,000", which is consistent.)

Boundary gap at exactly the Threshold: App B rows B1/C end "less than the Threshold" and row D starts "Above Threshold"; App C row E splits at "below" vs "greater than" the Threshold. A value equal to the Threshold is in neither band. App A row 1 "up to relevant Threshold" does include it.
App A row 4: band heading says "£2.5million or more" but the cell says "in excess of £2.5million". Extracted as inclusive per the band heading; exactly £2.5m is ambiguous.
App B row A starts "Above £1,000"; there is no procedure for purchases of £1,000 or less (may be intentional).

Band order conflict: App A row 2 ("Above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000") assumes the Threshold is below £500,000, while App B row C ("Above £500,000 and less than the Threshold" for works, concession and light touch) assumes it is above £500,000 for those types. App A bands cannot be applied to works contracts without resolving this.

Who may waive: 7.3 says "Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver", but 7.2.2 allows waiver "at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive". 7.4.1 requires S.151 approval "for all contracts up to the Threshold" with no lower bound, though 7.2 limits waivers to contracts over £24,999.99.

Drafting errors: 7.4.2 reads "the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report"; 7.5.2 lists "Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director" (Service Director twice); App C row E requires an "extension report" for a variation.

Numbering errors: 6.23 is a heading ("Evaluations of Quotes and Tenders"); 5.2 and 5.2.1 continue the 5.1 publication list; 1.6.1 and 1.6.2 continue the 1.6 bullet list. 7.1 and 7.7 say the same thing.
"relevant board" (5.3, 7.4.2, 7.4.3, 7.5.2, App A, App C) and "Corporate Board" (7.4.3) are not defined in the PDF.
App C closing note uses "exemption" although Appendix C is about "exclusion", and "annual or total value" leaves the basis open.

Mandatory vs advisory wording: 10.1 ("There should be written evidence of all purchases"), 9.3 ("should document"), 11.5 ("should be assessed for risk") and App B rows C and D advertising ("should be placed") use "should"; they are treated as rules because the action is concrete. 6.8 and 11.2 "should" were excluded as advisory.
Retention period: 9.2 says the report is "kept for three years" without a start date; 9.3 says "three years from the award of the contract".
6.11 refers to "tenderers from other member states", EU-era wording that may be out of date under PA2023.
Several rules are outside procurement transactions (sealing 11.6-11.9, legal proceedings 11.12, Counsel 11.14) but are extracted because they are testable; risk-assessor may scope them out.

rules.condition: procuring a service contract with estimated value above the Goods & Services Threshold
rules.required_action: consider and record how the procurement could improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, as required by the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012, and the Council’s Social Value Policy.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: ensure every contract rests on a decision of the Council, the Executive, or a decision-maker acting within the Scheme of Delegation
rules.approver: the Council; the Executive; or an Executive Decision Maker, Council Committee/Sub-Committee, or officer within the Scheme of Delegation
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision:

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: confirm an existing budgetary provision in the approved Budget before entering into the contract
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award with a value over £500,000
rules.required_action: treat and record the award as a Key Decision of the Council
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: expenditure exceeding £500
rules.required_action: publish details of the expenditure, including payments to suppliers and contractors
rules.verbatim_quote: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: invitation to tender for a goods/services contract with value exceeding £5,000
rules.required_action: publish details of every such invitation to tender
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: all contracts in progress or awarded
rules.required_action: publish a register of contracts with key information such as value, duration and supplier
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: all contracts
rules.required_action: report contract information to the relevant board monthly
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold (not a Further Competition under a compliant Framework)
rules.required_action: advertise on the CDP database before any other advertising medium
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium (such as a trade journal etc).

rules.condition: any CDP notice
rules.required_action: have the CDP notice approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or delegate
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate, who will also assist in the conduct of the procurement.

rules.condition: any requirement that is split or disaggregated
rules.required_action: do not split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: contract with estimated value more than the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: issue an electronic Invitation to Tender and receive tenders electronically via the Procurement Portal
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: any electronic tender
rules.required_action: specify the submission format and keep tenders locked in a secure portal account until the opening time
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: tender received after the specified opening time
rules.required_action: reject late tenders unless the Monitoring Officer accepts exceptional circumstances and no other tender has been opened
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: have a Procurement Officer open tenders electronically, with an audit record kept on the e-tendering system
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: any quote or tender evaluation
rules.required_action: evaluate quotes and tenders against criteria notified in advance to bidders
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: any contract award
rules.required_action: award on the most advantageous / best value quote or tender, not lowest price alone, unless an exception is approved in advance
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (for exceptions)
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: waiver of competition for a contract valued more than £24,999.99 (subject to 7.4)
rules.required_action: waive competition only where 7.2.1 (urgency, not subject to Procurement Legislation, risk of loss/injury/damage) or 7.2.2 (Executive Director/Chief Executive discretion, reasons recorded in writing) applies
rules.verbatim_quote: Subject to 7.4 the requirement for the Council to conduct a competitive purchasing process, contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

rules.condition: any waiver of or exception to these Rules
rules.required_action: obtain the waiver in advance, only in exceptional circumstances, from the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: obtain S.151 Officer approval of the exception
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer consults the Monitoring Officer and Executive Director; exception report approved by the relevant board (retrospective report only if 7.3 urgency applies)
rules.approver: S.151 Officer, after consulting the Monitoring Officer and appropriate Executive Director; relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency such prior approval is not possible in which case a report will be supplied retrospectively;

rules.condition: exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend to the Executive; exception report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.approver: the Executive (on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer); relevant board; Corporate Board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: fully document the exception or waiver
rules.verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must: 7.5.1 be fully documented;

rules.condition: exception or waiver where competition is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: submit a written exception report with reasons to the relevant board in advance
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (which shall include reasons for the exception or waiver which demonstrate that the exception or waiver is genuinely required);

rules.condition: any exception or waiver
rules.required_action: obtain S.151 Officer approval, recording that the reasons were considered and the circumstances are genuinely exceptional
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional

rules.condition: use of a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, dynamic market, consortium, etc.)
rules.required_action: obtain advice before use confirming legal entitlement, coverage of the purchases, and compliance of the scheme (8.2.1–8.2.3)
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: produce a written procurement report documenting key decisions and stages
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (author)
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation

rules.condition: each 9.1 procurement report
rules.required_action: retain the report for three years
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: all procurement procedures, regardless of value
rules.required_action: document the progress of the procedure and keep the documentation for three years from award
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (owner)
rules.verbatim_quote: In addition to the above, the relevant Service Director should document the progress of all procurement procedures (regardless of value) including ensuring sufficient information is kept to justify decisions such as communications with contractors and internal deliberations, preparation of procurement documents, any dialogue and negotiation, selection and award. Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: any purchase
rules.required_action: hold written (including electronic) evidence of the purchase
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: contracts as detailed in Appendix B
rules.required_action: put the contract in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: contract documents sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Legal Services retains all sealed contract documents
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: award of any contract
rules.required_action: formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement so the award is recorded on the Contract Register
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: include the standard clauses from the relevant Standard Form of Agreement
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued and updated from time to time by the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer and available from Legal Services.

rules.condition: amendment of a Standard Form of Agreement
rules.required_action: have the amended form approved by the Monitoring Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: any contract, where appropriate
rules.required_action: include minimum clauses on scope, timing, quality, insurance, default, legal compliance, data, bribery, payment and specifications (10.7.1–10.7.10)
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment to inform the data clauses
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: include a clause requiring Council payment within 30 days of a valid, undisputed invoice
rules.verbatim_quote: any payment due from the Council is made no later than 30 days from the date on which the relevant invoice is regarded as valid and undisputed;

rules.condition: any relaxation of full indemnities
rules.required_action: obtain written authorisation from the Monitoring Officer and S.151 Officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S.151 Officer (or nominated officers)
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: performance bond required under 11.2
rules.required_action: use a bond form approved by Legal Services and include it in the Invitation to Tender
rules.approver: Legal Services
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: contract within 11.2 (estimated over £500,000) where a performance bond is not considered necessary
rules.required_action: write a risk assessment, seek approval, and keep the risk assessment on the contract file (11.4.1–11.4.3)
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must: 11.4.1 undertake a risk assessment in writing; and 11.4.2 seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and 11.4.3 keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.condition: any contract
rules.required_action: assess the contract for risk; where insurance is needed, set and verify cover in consultation with Finance and Property (11.5.1–11.5.4)
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract should be assessed for risk. If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must:

rules.condition: the Common Seal
rules.required_action: keep the Seal in the custody of the Monitoring Officer in a safe place
rules.verbatim_quote: The Common Seal of the Council (the “Seal”) shall be in the Custody of the Monitoring Officer and kept in a safe place at their discretion.

rules.condition: any document to be sealed
rules.required_action: affix the Seal only to documents approved by the Council, Executive, a Committee, or an officer with delegated powers
rules.approver: the Council, Executive, an appropriate Committee, or an officer with delegated powers
rules.verbatim_quote: The Seal may be affixed, physically or electronically, to any document or proposal that has been approved by a resolution of the Council or Executive, or of an appropriate Committee, or by an officer with delegated powers.

rules.condition: any affixing of the Seal
rules.required_action: have the sealing attested and witnessed in writing
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or a duly designated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council.

rules.condition: every sealing of a document
rules.required_action: record the sealing in a consecutively numbered register signed by the attesting person
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose and shall be signed (including a digital signature) by the person attesting the sealing.

rules.condition: goods, services, works or concession contract valued above Threshold
rules.required_action: execute the contract under seal
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: document that is a necessary step in legal proceedings
rules.required_action: have it signed by the Monitoring Officer or a duly authorised officer
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or duly authorised officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where any document will be a necessary step in legal proceedings on behalf of the Council it shall, unless any enactment otherwise requires or authorises or the Council shall have given the necessary authority to some other person for the purpose of such proceedings, be signed by the Monitoring Officer or duly authorised officer.

rules.condition: documents executed on behalf of the Council not under seal
rules.required_action: keep a register of such documents
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or designated officer (signatory)
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: selection and instruction of Counsel
rules.required_action: only the Monitoring Officer (or nominee) selects and instructs Counsel
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer) shall have discretion to select and instruct Counsel.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or officers nominated in writing)
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: written report by the Service Director provided and approved by the relevant board before award
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director, on recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Key Decision; written report approved by the relevant board; Call-In and Forward Plan procedures followed
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, on recommendation of the Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided: a) a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board; and

rules.condition: Total Contract Value £2.5million or more
rules.required_action: obtain Executive approval (directly or via delegated authority sought through quarterly reports)
rules.approver: the Executive
rules.verbatim_quote: Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below.

rules.condition: Total Value (ex VAT) above £1,000 and less than £25,000
rules.required_action: seek at least one quote from an appropriate source; no advertising mandated
rules.verbatim_quote: At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods or services, Total Value (ex VAT) £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible; publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch, Total Value (ex VAT) £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME or VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible; publish a contract notice on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**).

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch, Total Value (ex VAT) above £500,000 and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: run a full competitive tender seeking at least five written tenders via the Procurement Portal; advertise on the Portal with information on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: any contract type, Total Value (ex VAT) above Threshold
rules.required_action: follow Procurement Legislation procedures: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders (where appropriate) via the Procurement Portal; advertise on the CDP
rules.verbatim_quote: Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal.

rules.condition: contract excluded from competition because it is excluded under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: obtain prior written approval (and relevant board approval where applicable)
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: record key decisions and follow the PSR process
rules.verbatim_quote: Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: contract awarded under a Purchasing Scheme without further competition
rules.required_action: obtain prior written approval (and relevant board approval where applicable)
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer; relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: extension of an existing contract that provides for such extension
rules.required_action: obtain S151 Officer approval of the extension
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is an extension to an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such extension. Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract, contract value below the Threshold
rules.required_action: obtain prior written approval of the variation
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required.

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract, contract value greater than the Threshold
rules.required_action: obtain relevant board approval after a report with Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer recommendation
rules.approver: relevant board, on recommendation of the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: social care services listed in row F a)–f) (individual placements, packages, Shared Lives)
rules.required_action: record the reasons for the choice of provider on the individual’s case notes
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual’s case notes.

rules.condition: any contract excluded from competition under Appendix C with annual or total value more than the Threshold
rules.required_action: obtain relevant board approval
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.
